en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's cook something
Let's go through the trash
Let's wash the dishes

Didn't I tell you before?
I'm not good at cooking.

When I hold a knife, I get super nervous
about nicking my own hand...

I'm a useless supreme leader of evil
who can't even hold a blade...
...But that's obviously a lie.
I don't even know myself...

But why do I like lying to you so much,
Shuichi?

You probably have a knack for pulling
the lies out of me.
You know me so well, Shuichi!

I love to look through trash more than
anything else in the world!

I get so obsessed with looking through trash
that I forget to eat or drink!
...But that's obviously a lie.

Maaan, when I'm with you, I have so much
fun that it makes me lie even more!
What!? I don't wanna deal with sloppy messes!

To tell you the truth, whenever I do the
dishes...a different personality comes out.

If that guy comes out,
everyone's lives will be in danger...
...Yeah, I'll pass on doing dishes.

<CLT=cltMIND>If you didn't want to,
you could have just said so...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
